briefing.bottom_line: ITC's revenue, operating income and free cash flow all rose in FY2026, and its FMCG and hotels segments grew fast. But total net income fell sharply, debt rose from Rs 285 crore to Rs 2,399 crore, and higher cigarette taxes cut quarterly profit by 20%.
